cohort: Live-born, non-anomalous singleton gestations from ≥ 36 to < 42 weeks of gestation in the United States between 2005 and 2013
finding: Both forceps and vacuum deliveries decreased significantly in the United States from 2005 to 2013.
mod_finding: The study found that both forceps and vacuum deliveries decreased from 2005 to 2013, with the authors suggesting this may limit access to alternatives to cesarean delivery.
